description: inblog connects your company blog to ChatGPT. Draft a post and get a private preview link before anything goes live, publish or schedule it, review traffic and Google Search Console keywords to decide what to write next, manage tags, authors and redirects, and update the blog's banner and custom design code. Requires an inblog account on the Team plan or higher; every action follows the permissions the signed-in user already has on that blog.

defaultPrompt: Draft a post about our new pricing and keep it unpublished so I can review it first
